context: Asuka lectures on how layers form in rock.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: science lecture; vocabulary (含ま/作ら/層/生じ/箇所) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 岩には、いくつもの層が含まれます。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 層は、どうやって作られるんですか?
lines.style: curious teen boy voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 長い時間をかけて、作られます。
lines.en: They're formed over a long time.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 隙間が、生じることもありますか?
lines.style: engaged teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、弱い箇所に隙間が生じます。
lines.en: Yes, gaps form at weak spots.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: その箇所は、どう調べるんですか?
lines.en: How do you examine those spots?
lines.style: thoughtful teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 層に含まれる成分を、調べます。
lines.en: We examine the components contained in the layers.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 層を見れば、歴史が分かるんですね。
lines.en: By looking at layers, we learn history.
lines.style: moved teen boy voice, soft warm realization throughout
